snippet.title: Dragon’s Dogma 2: Dark Arisen – Announcement Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
Dragon’s Dogma 2: Dark Arisen is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 on Oct 9, 2026!

The latest game in the Dragon's Dogma series comes with new content! Experience Capcom's dynamic action RPG together with your Pawn companions and venture into the all-new Norgan region—where the Relic Expedition Cycle from Dragon's Dogma: Dark Arisen makes a return.

#NintendoDirect #DD2A #NintendoSwitch2

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
